Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
spyd...@usa.pipeline.com(Kyle Watkins) writes:
>Hi, Im a newbie to V:TES, and I was wondering if someone could emailme an
>FAQ for the game, and a list of the cards, incl. which ones are restricted,
>etc.

WotC maintains no single FAQ for VtES (outside of one that isn't
available for public consumption). No one has a list of VtES cards,
although a list of Jyhad cards and a list of Dark SOvereigns cards
are available. No cards are restricted, except in official tournament
play (there aren't that many official tournaments). See the tournament
rules for that information.

The cardlists, unofficial summary of *all* errata and rulings, and
tournament rules can be gotten from my Jyhad page (and the official
page, which we are told will be up "RealSoonNow(tm)"), as well as
from Alec Habig's FTP site:

http://www.math.sc.edu/~sjohnson/jyhad
ftp://bigbang.astro.indiana.edu/pub/jyhad/

Messages.Author: AITOR
Messages.Body:
Hi!
Actually there is a list of V:tES in a magazine about trading cards
called 'THE DUELIST'. It appears in the number 7.
This article also mentions what cards were taken away from 'JYHAD', what
was added instead, and why. Besides lots of the changes in the text of
the cards.
The list is COMPLETE and the article is very good (IMHO). Actually, the
only problem of that magazine is that is centered in 'MAGIC the
GATHERING', but is really good anyway.
In different # are available the COMPLETE list for 'JYHAD' and DS.
Hope this helps everyone.
AITOR.

All the stuff between tics (' ') is trademark of their respective
owners. (Actually I think it's all from WotC).
